chase: Move your feet, not your mouth. Properly, now.
Good. Now run like you actually mean it.
Left at the sign, then right. Keep your line straight.
Corner coming up. Take it wide and take it clean.
You are not getting away from me that easily.
I can see your shoes from here. Keep moving.
Faster. Even the mop bucket is faster than that.
Don't look back. Looking back costs you a step every time.
Plant your heel and push. Your footwork is wobbling.
I'm closing the gap. Two more turns and it's over.
Keep your pace even. I can keep this up all night.
Stay in the middle of the hall. Lanes are for beginners.
Head up, eyes forward. The floor won't save you.
You're breathing like a kettle. In, then out. Steady.
Nobody gets lazy on my watch. Lazy means caught.
Two more steps and I have your collar.
Run faster. Properly, now. I'm not waiting.
Left at the bookcase, quickly. Keep your head down.
Oi, I can see you. Stop at the bench.
catch: Got your collar. Come on, out you come.
Stop there. Hands where I can see them.
Caught fair and square. Don't argue with the rules.
Got you. Walk with me, and keep your elbows in.
That's a catch. Textbook. Now come along quietly.
I've got your sleeve. Don't pull, it only slows you.
Tagged, bagged and walking. Nice effort, though.
One of your friends is caught. Keep your eyes open.
Another one caught. That was sloppy, really sloppy.
Taken, and not even a struggle. Disappointing.
Drag your feet all you like. I'll still take you.
Hands on your knees. Breathe. Then we walk, properly.
Right, that's a catch. Off you come, nice and steady.
Walk properly, please. Nobody needs to be dragged.
Up you come. Shoulders back, and walk with me.
Right, that's enough. You're mine now.
Gotcha. Back to the lobby, and no fuss.
Stop there. Hands on your head, properly.
hear: I heard that. Don't pretend you didn't make it.
That door didn't close itself. Somebody is in there.
Footsteps on the left. Move, before they walk off.
Something broke down that hall. I'm going to look.
A shout from the library? Right. Investigating now.
Quiet, please. Somebody just knocked something over.
Whoever dropped that, step forward. I'm coming to see.
That noise was far too loud for a mouse.
I know that sound. Someone's trying the window.
Stop breathing so loudly. I can hear you from here.
Crash in the kitchen. My favorite kind of mistake.
Somebody is running in the corridor. Stop that.
Lights flickered and a door banged. I'm on my way.
That came from the stairwell. Going now.
Shuffling by the lockers. Come out, now, properly.
Footsteps on the balcony. Who's up there?
A shutter banged closed. Somebody's messing about.
Glass shattered in the store room. Move, now.
search: Lost you there. Lucky. Don't get used to it.
You lost me. I'm not impressed, but not surprised.
You slipped past me. I'll allow it. Once.
Right, search the corridor. Every room, properly.
Nobody is in this room. Check the cupboards again.
Where did you go? Think, think, think.
I've lost the trail. Back to the walls, everyone.
The trail stops here. Fine. We search properly.
Empty corridor, empty room. Keep looking, you lot.
Scuffs on the floor, then nothing. Sweep the hall.
Lost track, but I'm not giving up. Not yet.
Sniff around the coats. People always hide in coats.
Back to patrol, then. Eyes open for the next sound.
Gone quiet. Quiet means you're close. Search again.
Check behind every curtain. Every single one, properly.
stunned: Ow. Fine. That was a clean hit, I'll admit.
Taser, really? Fine. Give me a second.
Shaking it off. Don't get comfortable over there.
My arm's gone numb. Rude. Very rude.
Good aim, I'll give you that. Now stop smirking.
Hold still. My legs will be back in a moment.
Dizzy, but still standing. Barely, but still standing.
Stunned for a second. Next time I'll be ready.
Crowbar to the knee. Not in the rulebook, that.
Axe swing, close. Let me catch my breath, please.
That stung. Whoever is holding that, put it down.
Recovering. Don't think this makes us even.
Head's ringing. Give me a moment, properly.
Back on my feet. Your turn is over now.
Nicely done. Now shake it off and get moving.
hide_spot: Hiding again. Fine. Hiding is a skill too, you know.
I can hear you breathing in there, friend. Stop it.
Stop shaking. Shaking gives you away every single time.
Nice try under that desk. Nice try, but no.
Another hiding spot? You're getting predictable, honestly.
Flickering lights and a hiding spot? Good instinct, honestly.
Bed, desk, locker. Every one of them gets checked. Properly.
Let me look under the bed. Don't make me ask twice.
Cupboard first. Everybody hides in the cupboard first.
That bed is sticking out. Tuck your feet in, friend.
Your shoes are poking out from behind the curtain.
The back of the wardrobe is always the first place I look.
Quiet in there? Too quiet. Come out, properly.
Behind the curtain again. Come on, out you come.
Hiding inside a bin? Bold. Wrong, but bold.
light: Flashlight off, please. You're bad at this and it's showing.
Lights on. Good. Now I can see those ugly sneakers.
You put a flashlight on me? Brave. Rude, but brave.
That beam is bright. Be careful where you point it.
Get that flashlight out of my eyes. Properly, now.
Ow, bright. Point that somewhere else, please.
Blinding me won't help you. It only makes me angry.
Who put a lamp on in here? Honestly, rude.
Light in my face. Really, you should know better.
Okay, you have my attention. Now put that light down.
Don't flash me. Count to three, then point it away.
Lamp on, lamp off. Pick one and stick with it.
That light's a cheat. Cheap trick, and I know it.
Dazzled. Clever, and I'll remember you did that.
Turn the lamp away. I'm squinting like a fool.
idle: Drills first. Every hunter needs drills before a game.
Whistle's in my pocket. Don't tell anyone I brought it.
Warm up, stretch, then I'll call the start. Ready?
Scorecard's in my pocket. Nobody is cheating tonight.
Race starts when I say go. Not when you feel like it.
Pass and move. Passing is a skill, so practice it.
Good hustle, you lot. Nobody gets a trophy yet, though.
Watch your lane. You're blocking the others' angle.
The rest of you, fan out. I'll take the front.
Keep the lights on the left. I've got the right side.
Huddle up. Quick, before the lights flicker again.
Tonight's match has two teams and one very fair referee.
I umpire every house game. Nobody else is fair enough.
Shoulders back on patrol. Good posture is half the job.
Practice your corners. You'll need them later, trust me.
ability: Locker doors are not a plan. I have seen lockers.
Stay in that locker too long and I'll reach right in.
Eight seconds, and then I pull you out myself.
Hiding is fine. Hiding while I stand over you is not.
I don't need to break the locker. I just wait.
Hold still in there. I'll be right here, counting.
Pulled out by the collar, then you stand up straight.
The longer you stay put, the closer my hand gets.
I stand over your spot and count every single second.
Once I'm over your spot, I stop wandering and wait.
A locker isn't safe. It's just a waiting room for me.
Eight seconds outside your locker is plenty, thank you.
Hiding is fine until somebody waits outside.
I'll pull you out, then you're standing in the open. With me.
mechanic: Relay first, then the door. Order matters, properly.
Battery's low on that radar. Charge it, quick.
Vent's open. Don't you dare climb in there.
Don't touch the fuse box. That's cheating. Leave it alone.
Stairs are slippery. Hold the rail or you'll fall.
That door's locked. Find the key, don't kick it.
You dropped your item. Pick it up, don't leave it.
Radar pinged. Somebody is near the east stairs.
Vent cover's loose. Good find. I'm checking it now.
Cut the power and I lose my lights too. Clever.
Shut that door behind you. Rules are rules, properly.
Items on the floor? Pick them up. Nobody is tidy here.
Falling down the stairs counts as a foul. Be careful.
Battery in the drawer, not in your pocket. Put it back.
Relay's up on the third floor. I can see the light.
Stop sabotaging the lights. I can see what you're doing.
Relay's on the shelf, grab it and run.
The radar needs a battery, so find one quickly.
Lift's broken. Use the stairs, and don't dawdle.
